## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, previous behavior and resulting behavior. Link a reproducer or issue when available.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their outcomes. Distinguish synthetic measurements, parser tests, service integration and unexecuted checks.

## Compatibility and confidence

Describe changes to source identities, context fingerprints, scan coverage, index schemas or authority boundaries. If the change adds a detector, explain its candidate status and how a reviewer can confirm or refute it.
